Morsø is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from national registries like LPR and DanStroke [^src1]. 

Specifically, Morsø's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical outputs for this indicator, including event counts and confidence intervals, are recorded in the detailed municipal breakdown on page 95 of the report [^src1]. Because the available corpus data consists solely of this single statistical table entry, no further details regarding Morsø's broader healthcare relationships or historical timeline are documented.
